About the PXG 0317 CB

Product description from PXG

Pure feel. Tour control. Forgiving precision. The PXG 0317 CB Irons are designed for accomplished golfers who want the look, feel, and control of a tour iron, with added forgiveness built in.

Forged from premium soft carbon steel, the 0317 CB delivers an exceptionally smooth, responsive feel at impact. The compact cavity-back design redistributes weight to the perimeter of the clubhead, increasing stability and forgiveness while maintaining the clean, traditional shape preferred by confident ball strikers.

Read the full descriptionShow less

PXG 0317 CB Irons

Precision-milled faces and refined shaping provide consistent spin and distance control, allowing you to flight shots, shape the ball, and attack pins with confidence. Compared to a blade, the CB offers added margin for error, making it ideal for players who want control without sacrificing playability.

Why Choose PXG 0317 CB

  • Soft forged feel with tour-level feedback

  • Compact cavity-back design for added forgiveness

  • Consistent distance and spin control

  • Clean, traditional shaping preferred by better players

Ideal For

  • Low- to mid-handicap golfers

  • Players seeking a blend of control, feel, and forgiveness

  • Golfers who want a players iron without going full blade

Questions

What does 5-PW mean?

The set runs from the 5-iron to the pitching wedge. 5-PW (6 clubs); 4-PW (7 clubs).

Steel or graphite?

Graphite shafts are lighter, which many golfers find easier to swing; steel is heavier and gives more feedback. If you’re unsure, our team can talk it through.

When will it arrive?

Made to order with your set, shaft and flex. Dispatch time to be confirmed.

Can I change the length, lie or grip?

Yes: build it in the custom club builder, or call our team on 0330 122 7089.
